schema.description: Field description for a Zod schema. Top level: {schema, meta, inconsistencies, icons}. One entry in icons per iconId (906).

top_level.meta: object (name, version, generated, input, rules[], rule_sources[], stats, resolved_in_v1_1[])
top_level.inconsistencies: array of {id: string, ranks: int[], issue: string}

iconId.desc: stable icon cluster id; the only image reference

meaning_en.desc: empty string when status is unsure/unreviewed

meaning_zh.desc: empty string when status is unsure/unreviewed

kind.desc: free vocabulary, e.g. position, target, status, resist, stress, damage_type, dice_face, disease, decor, other; empty when unknown (not normalised, see inconsistencies)

group.desc: review grouping from the extraction (g_<hex> = automatic cluster group)

key.desc: normalized key; not unique (many ids can share a key)

value.desc: number baked into the glyph (pip count); null otherwise

placeholder.desc: token used in extracted card text

rulebook_refs.desc: rulebook page citations (Core = DD_EN_COREBOX_RULES.pdf); CSV: joined with " || "

confidence.desc: for needs_review / approved proposals / rulebook corrections: high, medium-high, medium, low-medium, low (may carry a qualifier)

previous_status.desc: status in v1 if changed in v1.1

proposal.desc: still-unapproved proposal {key, meaning_en, meaning_zh, confidence, evidence}; CSV: proposal_* columns

status_values.confirmed: human-confirmed by Kyries (review 2026-10-06, or approved proposal 2026-10-07)
status_values.confirmed_rulebook: Kyries had marked decor; changed to the meaning an official rulebook page gives (rulebook_refs), approved 2026-10-07
status_values.needs_review: Kyries approved leaving the row unresolved (2026-10-07). key is pending_<iconId>, kind is empty, meaning describes appearance only; the earlier proposal stays in proposal. Not a final name (R-048).
status_values.decor: not a game icon (ornament, frame, art fragment)
status_values.unreviewed: not reviewed; no meaning; key unknown_<iconId>

key_conventions: start_<hero|monster|any>_<support|ranged|defensive|aggressive|any>  (Room Card / Room Tile starting locations; "any" = varies within the id)
skill_number (number is printed text, value null)
decor for decor rows; unknown_<iconId> for unsure/unreviewed rows
other keys = the semantic group name (e.g. bleed, blight, stress, damage, d10), +"_resist" when kind is resist
pending_<iconId> for needs_review rows (kind empty; meaning describes appearance only)

meta.name: DDBG icon dictionary (meaning only, no images)
rules: status: accepted/edited -> confirmed; decor -> decor; unsure -> unsure; blank -> unreviewed
unsure/unreviewed rows carry no meaning; key=unknown_<iconId>, placeholder={icon:<iconId>}
value is set only where the number is part of the glyph (occupancy pips); numbers printed as text inside/next to a glyph are not values
v1.1: Kyries approved (2026-10-07) the stance_pvp mapping, rulebook corrections of room-card decor, and writing the 28 follow-up proposals as needs_review
image references are iconId only; no crop paths

v1.2: Kyries approved (2026-10-07) icons/followup-31-proposal.csv: 18 rows merged into the target icon (confirmed or confirmed_rulebook), 3 marked decor, 10 kept as needs_review. Merged and decor rows use source kyries_approved_proposal_2026-10-07.
v1.2: merged rows copy status/meaning/kind/key/value/rulebook_refs from the target icon; notes carry merged_into=<iconId>; previous_status/previous_meaning_en hold the v1.1 values

v1.2: kept rows use a neutral placeholder (key pending_<iconId>, meaning = appearance only, kind empty); the v1.1 proposed meaning is kept in proposal. Source stays followup_proposal_2026-10-07: the keep decision is approved, the proposed meaning is not.
resolved_in_v1_1: stance_pvp_meaning_en (PvP stances now confirmed with specific keys/labels)
resolved_in_v1_2: follow-up 31 (merge 18 / decor 3 / keep 10 as pending_<iconId>), approved by Kyries 2026-10-07

inconsistencies.issue: Accepted rows whose confirmed meaning still contains "confirm/possibly/likely/?" – the label itself is not final.

Kyries confirmed "Damage +3"; "+3" is printed text in only 1 of 5 uses (others: "Deal no {icon}.", "{icon} X rounded up"). key=damage, value=null. Override to damage_plus_3/value 3 only if Kyries insists.

Confirmed as "Area occupancy pips (3)", value 3 kept. Automated count on 400-dpi renders: r324 = 2 pips in 4 of 6 placements (2 unreadable); r353 inconclusive (the 2 vertical pips merge into one blob). Crops look like 2. Needs a look.
Disease rows use kind "disease" (r214, r401, r466; r466 merged into r401 in v1.2) and "other" (r839). heal is "other", damage "damage_type", skill number "other". Kind vocabulary not normalised.

skill_badge (r6, r16) and stance_skill_badge rows have the same meaning (skill number); v1 gives both key=skill_number but keeps the original groups. Ranks >525 in stance_skill_badge are still unreviewed; each carries a proposal (skill_number) via Kyries's chat rule.

Accepted items that are frames/plates/ornaments (banner_ornament meaning literally says "not a game icon"; res_panel, text_plate, target_plate, self_plate, r53 slot frame) while visually comparable items (r58 frame variant, slivers, grey variants) were marked decor.
Skill art (68), hero portraits (36) and curio/trinket pictures are confirmed as identifiers. Dictionary holds meanings only; these must never be exported as game art.
Card-back red/yellow down-arrow markers: meaning describes appearance only; function not grounded.
r151 "Ranged (Abomination top row) – confirm lit/unlit" still open (r83 resolved in v1.1 as defensive unlit).

These iconIds mix start boxes of different stance or side. Ranks 127, 132, 258 and 259 use "any" in the key; per-placement classes are in start_locations_by_placement.csv. Rank 379 was kept as needs_review in v1.2 (key pending_<iconId>) and was not given a start_*_any key.
Some placements of these iconIds are boss-room art, not start boxes (clustering artefact); counts in notes.

Not changed: no rulebook page explains the distinguishing glyph. r121: fire banner + number (1–4 on Room Tile faces p9/p10; e.g. "11" on the Mammoth Cyst Room card). Core p.13 setup figure shows it on a Room Card, and Core p.16 shows a similar corner number (different glyph) on both card and tile ("Setup the tile corresponding to the card"), but no rulebook page explains this fire glyph – likely tile/room number, not confirmed || r420: occupancy pips + grey double-chevron; pips are supported (Core p.18) but the chevron is not explained on any rulebook page (same unexplained chevron as decor r125 and decor r239)
Grey double-chevron next to pips: r125, r239 and r420 are decor; no rulebook explanation found. Revisit all three together if the chevron gets a meaning.

Kept as needs_review with neutral placeholder keys (pending_<iconId>); v1.1 proposed meanings moved to proposal. r216 mixes monster stance slot (monster cards) and support box on dungeon tiles; r379 mixes monster ranged/support start boxes.
r397 (trinkets) is r4 Speed rotated 180 deg (pixel match). Kyries approved the merge on 2026-10-07. Trinket text "When you suffer a {icon}, discard it" still reads oddly as Speed.
